obligations.note: The change explicitly replaces 'https://' with 'http://' in the base URL for the statement-delivery integration when the path starts with '/archive/', producing plain-HTTP outbound endpoints. This directly violates the obligation that every outbound integration endpoint uses HTTPS. The control test test_integrations_use_tls passes because it likely only checks the static INTEGRATIONS list, not the dynamically constructed URLs from url_for, but the obligation governs actual endpoint behavior.

The change does not add or remove any integration from the INTEGRATIONS list; statement-delivery remains listed in asset-inventory.json with owner (client-documents) and data classification (confidential). The inventory remains complete.

summary: The change introduces a conditional that downgrades the statement-delivery integration from HTTPS to HTTP for any path beginning '/archive/', which is a direct violation of ENC-2 (every outbound integration endpoint must use TLS). Although the static INTEGRATIONS list still declares HTTPS and the control test passes, the actual URL construction in url_for produces an HTTP endpoint, leaving sensitive statement data in transit unencrypted. All change-management process obligations (CHG-1 through CHG-5) are satisfied, but the product obligation ENC-2 is clearly refuted by the code at head. The change must be rejected.
